text:
SY316
Sociology of Education
0.5 Credit
Hours per week:
Lecture/Discussion: 3
An examination of educational institutions in
terms
of social reproduction and social change in local and global contexts. Topics covered may include theoretical perspectives on education, historical legacies of schooling and nation building, and social inequality.

Additional Course Information
Prerequisites
SY207
(or SY203*) or possession of an Ontario Teacher's Certificate (or its equivalent).
Exclusions
NU2095 (Nipissing University)
